test_title: PYST 16: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 14 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All triangles are compasses.

All squares are compasses.

Conclusions:

(I) Some triangles are squares.

(II) Some compasses are squares.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is shown below according to the given information.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f3b5a4785fadf762c516d680ecd54ec038a755557336d66f2ec4b637474ab1c.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some triangles are squares. - Does not follow [ As no definite relation given between triangles and square, so it can be possible only]

(II) Some compasses are squares.- Follow ( All squares are compasses means some squares are compasses and Some compasses are squares) 

Only conclusion (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
